mapper.insert: insert into a2a_result_processing(tenant_id,a2a_result_id,a2a_request_id,parent_task_id,child_task_id,processing_status,reconciliation_classification,last_error_code,last_error,attempt_count,next_reconcile_at,last_reconciled_at,completed_at,created_at,updated_at,row_version) values(#{processing.tenantId},#{processing.resultId},#{processing.requestId},#{processing.parentTaskId},#{processing.childTaskId},#{processing.processingStatus},#{processing.reconciliationClassification},#{processing.lastErrorCode},#{processing.lastError},#{processing.attemptCount},#{processing.nextReconcileAt},#{processing.lastReconciledAt},#{processing.completedAt},coalesce(#{processing.createdAt},now()),coalesce(#{processing.updatedAt},now()),#{processing.rowVersion}) on conflict(tenant_id,a2a_result_id) do nothing
mapper.update: update a2a_result_processing set processing_status=#{processing.processingStatus},reconciliation_classification=#{processing.reconciliationClassification},last_error_code=#{processing.lastErrorCode},last_error=#{processing.lastError},attempt_count=#{processing.attemptCount},next_reconcile_at=#{processing.nextReconcileAt},last_reconciled_at=#{processing.lastReconciledAt},completed_at=#{processing.completedAt},updated_at=#{processing.updatedAt},row_version=#{processing.rowVersion} where tenant_id=#{processing.tenantId} and a2a_result_id=#{processing.resultId} and row_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select * from a2a_result_processing where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_result_id=#{resultId}

select * from a2a_result_processing where processing_status in ('CHILD_COMPLETION_PENDING','CHILD_COMPLETED','PARENT_AGGREGATION_PENDING','FAILED_RETRYABLE') and coalesce(next_reconcile_at,now()) <= #{dueAt} order by coalesce(next_reconcile_at,created_at) asc limit #{limit}
select * from a2a_result_processing where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and (parent_task_id=#{taskId} or child_task_id=#{taskId}) order by created_at desc limit #{limit}
